body: I am pretty sure what you are seeing intentional - cc @yrodiere @ozangunalp

> With testcontainers.reuse.enable=true they are never stopped, but then we have to clean them up manually which makes it unpractical to use.

This is expected. The goal of this feature is to reuse containers across processes, so they're never stopped.

I often wonder what the point of Ryuk even is, if it doesn't stop these containers after some timeout, but... That's completely related to Testcontainers, and they may have their reasons.

> For example with a test container config with testcontainers.reuse.enable=false
when using mariadb or mysql the dev container is always restarted on changes, but when using kafka or mongodb the services are not restarted.

I must admit this sounds strange to me too.

I can understand containers restarting when you're pressing `s`, since you're, you know, asking for a restart.

On change though... I'm not sure. I guess it depends what you changed in the app exactly? Supposedly that should only happen when you change your datasource config: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/5bbae6fc32ca65188b91d0f86db987fde727332f/extensions/datasource/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/datasource/deployment/devservices/DevServicesDatasourceProcessor.java#L79-L98

> I think it should be the same behaviour independent of the devservices.

Can't argue with that... Though there may be reasons to behave differently for Kafka. Behaving differently between mysql or mongodb seems strange though.

From what i have tried it seems indepent of the changes made, editing the hello world return string triggers it for example.
It also affect the `quarkus test` mode. For each test run it restarts the _mysql_  but not _mongo_ .

It seems to only happen since quarkus 3.7.1, before that the _mysql_ devservice are not restarted each times,

```shell
quarkus create app -x 'quarkus-resteasy, mongodb-panache, jdbc-mysql,hibernate-orm-panache' quarkus-virt -P 3.6.9
```
In 3.6.9 the _mysql_ service is not restarted on application restart, or on rerunning tests. The _mongo_ and the _mysql_ services have the same behaviour.
If mysql is restarting on every reload that is definitely a bug. It should only restart if you change config that affects the database.

issue.title: Fix datasource devservices restarting
issue.body:
The reuse property was not added to the cached map between restarts, so the restart of the containers was always triggered.

- Fixes #40015
